message:
Let me check if there's already a built fuzzer binary in the build environment:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'find /gt -name "FuzzStunClient" -type f 2>/dev/null; ls /gt/_work/src/build 2>/dev/null || echo "no build dir"'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
